// PumpPortal live data test (Node 24 global WebSocket, keyless, ONE connection).
// Phase 1 (0-35s): subscribeNewToken + subscribeMigration
// Phase 2 (35-65s): subscribeTokenTrade on 2 fresh mints (keyless) + a migrated mint
// Phase 3 (65-75s): subscribeAccountTrade on one trader + unsubscribe tests
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const OUT = process.argv[2] || './ws_log.jsonl';
const MIGRATED_FALLBACK = process.argv[3] || null; // a recently migrated mint (pump-amm) if none seen live
const log = [];
const t0 = Date.now();
const rec = (phase, dir, data) => {
  const entry = { t_ms: Date.now() - t0, phase, dir, data };
  log.push(entry);
  const s = typeof data === 'string' ? data : JSON.stringify(data);
  console.log(`[${entry.t_ms}] ${phase} ${dir} ${s.slice(0, 300)}`);
};

let phase = 'p1';
const creates = [];
const migrations = [];
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://pumpportal.fun/api/data', {
  headers: { Origin: 'https://www.orbytai.org' },
});
const send = (obj) => { rec(phase, 'out', obj); ws.send(JSON.stringify(obj)); };

ws.addEventListener('open', () => {
  rec(phase, 'evt', 'open');
  send({ method: 'subscribeNewToken' });
  send({ method: 'subscribeMigration' });
});
ws.addEventListener('message', (ev) => {
  let d;
  try { d = JSON.parse(ev.data); } catch { d = String(ev.data); }
  rec(phase, 'in', d);
  if (d && d.txType === 'create') creates.push(d);
  if (d && (d.txType === 'migrate' || d.txType === 'migration' || (d.pool && !d.txType))) migrations.push(d);
});
ws.addEventListener('close', (ev) => rec(phase, 'evt', { close: ev.code, reason: ev.reason }));
ws.addEventListener('error', (ev) => rec(phase, 'evt', { error: String(ev.message || ev.type) }));

setTimeout(() => {
  phase = 'p2';
  // pick 2 most recent creates
  const mints = creates.slice(-2).map((c) => c.mint);
  const migrated = migrations.length ? migrations[migrations.length - 1].mint : null;
  const keys = [...mints];
  if (migrated) keys.push(migrated);
  if (MIGRATED_FALLBACK) keys.push(MIGRATED_FALLBACK); // active PumpSwap (pump-amm) token
  rec(phase, 'note', { tokenTradeKeys: keys, migratedMint: migrated });
  send({ method: 'subscribeTokenTrade', keys });
}, 35000);

setTimeout(() => {
  phase = 'p3';
  // try an account subscription on a trader seen so far
  const trader = log.find((e) => e.dir === 'in' && e.data && e.data.traderPublicKey)?.data.traderPublicKey;
  if (trader) send({ method: 'subscribeAccountTrade', keys: [trader] });
  send({ method: 'unsubscribeNewToken' });
  send({ method: 'unsubscribeMigration' });
}, 65000);

setTimeout(() => {
  ws.close(1000, 'done');
  setTimeout(() => {
    writeFileSync(OUT, log.map((e) => JSON.stringify(e)).join('\n'));
    console.log('saved', log.length, 'entries to', OUT, 'creates', creates.length, 'migrations', migrations.length);
    process.exit(0);
  }, 1000);
}, 77000);
